name: blast-radius
description: Holds risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, git clean, force push, migrations) and shows what they would change; answered with Proceed or Cancel on any device, Remote Control included

answer.title: How to ask
answer.description: auto: a pane with the report where a screen draws Claude Code, the native question elsewhere (Remote Control). ask: always the native question, which the terminal and every attached device show. pane: always the pane.
